fact: At a meeting chaired by the health minister on 12 November 2020, a year after DHIS2 was introduced, the ministry's director of health information, who leads the project, reported a roadmap with a budget and timetable, a steering committee and technical team, and end users trained at the CSC and CMH, and said DHIS2 was operational at levels 1 and 2 of the health pyramid with routine data reaching his directorate, hospital (level 3) data not yet being integrated.
title: Première évaluation du DHIS2 depuis son introduction dans la gestion des informations sanitaires
publisher: Ministère de la Santé de Djibouti
